packageRules.description: Members of the pub workspace have no pubspec.lock beside them (the lock is at the root), and Renovate can't regenerate a workspace lock from a member (renovatebot/renovate#40361, not planned). Their updates within constraints arrive through lockFileMaintenance at the root; major bumps in a member's pubspec are manual.
The Dart SDK constraint follows from the Flutter pin (Flutter bundles Dart), so don't bump it separately.
Flutter SDK releases: the pin in the root pubspec's environment.flutter. Renovate regenerates pubspec.lock on the new version in the same PR.
